question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 2,560. During a sale, two successive discounts of 20% and x% are offered on it. If the selling price of the article is Rs. 1,679.36, then the value of x is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price of the article = Rs.2560

Successive Discounts rates = 20% and x%

Selling Price of the article = Rs.1679.36 

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (100 - Discount)%

**Calculation:**

Rs.1679.36 = Rs.2560 × (100 - 20)% × (100 - x)% 

⇒ 1679.36 = 2560 × 80/100 × (100 - x)/100 

⇒ 167936/100 × 100/80 × 100/2560 = (100 - x)

⇒ 20992/256 = 100 - x

⇒ 82 = 100 - x 

**∴ x = 18 **
